propositions: Project-configured code-review criteria merge successfully into the workflow overlay but do not execute or evaluate end-to-end, appearing as silent failures indistinguishable from empty findings

The code-review runtime must implement a generic, project-id-agnostic execution seam that reuses plan-review's fan-in pattern to execute activated project criteria exactly once per review without workflow DSL changes

Logical project criterion ids must map to sanitized physical prompt ids following the pattern code-review-project-<name-with-dots-replaced-by-dashes>, with resolution occurring only during asset dispatch
Activated missing or malformed project prompt/eval assets must raise a fatal located LLMError before model execution rather than silently skipping or emitting empty findings

Pass 3 deterministic decision logic must apply repository-effective routing (thresholds, blocking posture, nit-suppression) to project criteria using only logical ids, computed once without LLM invocation
